_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Potion Making#000.src: Talk to The Assistant in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Potion Making#000.dst: 到 {p} 的 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 跟 The Assistant 談話

Potion Making#001.dst: 嘿嘿……陌生人。我……可能需要你的協助……
Potion Making#001.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#002.src: My master...wishes to create a very dangerous potion...a transformative elixir of invincibility...
Potion Making#002.dst: 我的主人……想調製一種非常危險的藥劑……一種能讓人刀槍不入的變質靈藥……
Potion Making#002.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#003.src: I was...in support of this... but then, he accrued essence of...the corruption. I had to run away...
Potion Making#003.dst: 我原本……是支持他的……可是後來，他弄來了……腐敗的精華。我只好逃走……
Potion Making#003.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#004.src: I fear...that he may be going...too far. I need your help...
Potion Making#004.dst: 我怕……他已經走得太遠了。我需要你的幫忙……
Potion Making#004.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#005.src: I want...to stop him...but I need you to...get me the necessary ingredients... to neutralize the potion...
Potion Making#005.dst: 我想……阻止他……但我需要你幫我……弄來必要的材料……好把那藥劑中和掉……
Potion Making#005.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#006.src: Get me...[{~} Red Mushroom], they can be found outside the east gate behind me.
Potion Making#006.dst: 幫我弄來……[{~} Red Mushroom]，我後面東門外就找得到。
Potion Making#006.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#007.src: Slay Mooshrooms near and bring [{~} Red Mushrooms] to The Assistant in {p}
Potion Making#007.dst: 在 {p} 附近擊殺哞菇，並把 [{~} Red Mushrooms] 帶給 The Assistant

Potion Making#008.src: Quickly, get me... [{~} Red Mushroom] as I asked... go through the {p} outside the east gate from here.
Potion Making#008.dst: 快，照我說的……幫我弄 [{~} Red Mushroom] 來……從這裡出東門，穿過 {p}。
Potion Making#008.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#009.dst: 那些……那些……牛。從牠們身上……搶。
Potion Making#009.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#012.src: I'll... return to my master's house...and sneak the mushrooms into...his potion. Wait for me here...
Potion Making#012.dst: 我……回主人家一趟……把蘑菇偷偷混進……他的藥劑裡。你在這裡等我……
Potion Making#012.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#013.src: I...have returned... He came back...just as I finished slipping the mushrooms in and...told me...to get out.
Potion Making#013.dst: 我……回來了……我剛把蘑菇放進去……他就回來了，然後……叫我……滾出去。
Potion Making#013.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#014.src: You must...ensure that it has worked. You...are much stronger than I, stranger...
Potion Making#014.dst: 你必須……確認它有沒有生效。你……比我強太多了，陌生人……
Potion Making#014.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#015.src: Did you see the orange witch hat roofed hut when you were gathering the mushrooms?
Potion Making#015.dst: 你採蘑菇的時候，有沒有看到一間屋頂像橘色女巫帽的小屋？
Potion Making#015.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#016.src: That is my master's house, you...must go back out the east gate and enter the hut.
Potion Making#016.dst: 那就是我主人的家，你……得再出東門一趟，進到那間小屋裡去。
Potion Making#016.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#017.src: You must...make sure...he has not managed...to become invincible... Do what has to be done....
Potion Making#017.dst: 你必須……確保……他沒有真的……變成刀槍不入的樣子……該做的事，就去做……
Potion Making#017.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#018.src: Enter the hut at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and slay Essren, and take his coat.
Potion Making#018.dst: 進入 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的小屋，擊殺 Essren 並取得他的外套。

Potion Making#019.src: You must go back out the east gate and enter the hut, it is my master's house.
Potion Making#019.dst: 你得再出東門一趟，進到那間小屋，那是我主人的家。
Potion Making#019.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#020.src: Don't forget... Do what you must...
Potion Making#020.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#021.src: Ah, you must be the one my assistant told me about.
Potion Making#021.dst: 啊，你就是我助手跟我提過的那個人吧。
Potion Making#021.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#022.src: If you are trying to stop me, it's too late. I already drank the pot...
Potion Making#022.dst: 如果你是來阻止我的，那已經太遲了。我已經把那鍋——
Potion Making#022.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#023.src: What is this taste? Mushrooms? This can't b
Potion Making#023.dst: 這是什麼味道？蘑菇？不可能——
Potion Making#023.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#025.src: What have you done to this potion, human?! You will pay for it!
Potion Making#025.dst: 你對這藥劑做了什麼，人類？！我要你付出代價！
Potion Making#025.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#026.src: Bring back Essren's Dusty Coat to The Assistant in {p}
Potion Making#026.dst: 把 Essren 的塵封外套帶回 {p} 給 The Assistant

Potion Making#028.src: Don't believe...everything people tell you... If master managed to...discover invincibility... No...too...dangerous.
Potion Making#028.dst: 別相信……別人跟你說的每一句話……要是主人真的……讓人變得刀槍不入……不……太……危險了。
Potion Making#028.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#030.src: Now. I...do not want you saying anything about...these events. Take these, and...never speak of this again.
Potion Making#030.dst: 好了。我……不希望你對外提起……這些事。拿著這些，然後……永遠別再提起。
Potion Making#030.speaker: The Assistant
